payout_quote: BONUS Coupon. To receive the $100 bonus, the minimum direct deposit to the checking account must be in the amount of $750 or higher per month. Member needs to notify the credit union within 60 days after the initial direct deposit has been received by Scient FCU to receive the $100 bonus. The $100 bonus will be added to the member's savings account within 30 days of notification. Checking account must remain open for 12 months and have a direct deposit with minimum amount of $750/month or the bonus will be debited (subtracted) from the account balance at closing. This bonus will be reported to the IRS as a dividend.
steps: Open a new individual checking account at Scient FCU (deposit at least $25; not available to members who already have a Scient checking account).
Set up and receive a verified direct deposit of at least $750 per month to the checking account.
Notify the credit union within 60 days after the initial direct deposit is received.
Receive the $100 bonus added to your savings account within 30 days of notification.
Keep the checking account open for 12 months with a $750+/month direct deposit to avoid the clawback.
catches: Verified direct deposit of $750 or more PER MONTH is required - a meaningful payroll commitment.
Must notify the credit union within 60 days after the initial direct deposit or the bonus is forfeited.
Checking must stay open for 12 months with the $750/month DD, or the bonus is debited back at closing (clawback).
One bonus per account number; members who already have a Scient checking account are ineligible.
Existing checking members excluded; individual accounts only.
Bonus reported to the IRS as a dividend (taxable).
Offer can be modified or withdrawn at any time without notice - no stated expiry.
biggest_catch: The $100 bonus claws back if the checking account is closed within 12 months or if the $750/month direct deposit lapses - and you must proactively notify the credit union within 60 days of your first direct deposit to get paid at all.
eligibility: New Scient FCU checking members with individual accounts; Scient FCU field-of-membership required (verify at scientfcu.com). Not available to members who already have a Scient checking account.
timing: Bonus added to savings within 30 days after the member notifies the CU (which must happen within 60 days of the first qualifying direct deposit). No expiry stated.
weasel_words: modified or withdrawn at any time
